source: Confirmed — not individually enumerable (see note) — see note: Not a fixed operation enum like the other Purview workloads. Microsoft logs nearly every SDK message in the Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Messages namespace (create/read/update/delete, multi-record view, export to Excel, report view/export/render, and all other SDK-layer calls against Dataverse -- hundreds of distinct message names, one per entity/action combination) EXCEPT an explicit exclusion list of ~26 messages (WhoAmI, RetrieveFilteredForms, TriggerServiceEndpointCheck, QueryExpressionToFetchXml, FetchXmlToQueryExpression, FireNotificationEvent, RetrieveMetadataChanges, RetrieveEntityChanges, RetrieveProvisionedLanguagePackVersion, RetrieveInstalledLanguagePackVersion, RetrieveProvisionedLanguages, RetrieveAvailableLanguages, RetrieveDeprovisionedLanguages, RetrieveInstalledLanguagePacks, GetAllTimeZonesWithDisplayName, GetTimeZoneCodeByLocalizedName, IsReportingDataConnectorInstalled, LocalTimeFromUtcTime, IsBackOfficeInstalled, FormatAddress, IsSupportUserRole, IsComponentCustomizable, ConfigureReportingDataConnector, CheckClientCompatibility, RetrieveAttribute). Requests are additionally bucketed into categories by name prefix (RetrieveMultiple/ExportToExcel/RollUp/etc. -> 'ReadMultiple'; Retrieve/Search/Get/Export -> 'Read'). The full literal message list lives in a separate, unrelated .NET SDK reference (Microsoft.Crm.Sdk.Messages Namespace on learn.microsoft.com), not in an audit-log operation table -- copying that huge SDK namespace in as if it were documented audit-log operation values would misrepresent its source, so it is not done here. Source: Microsoft Learn (MicrosoftDocs/power-platform GitHub repo, main branch) — activity-logs-dataverse-model-driven-apps.md.

source: Confirmed — not individually enumerable (see note) — see note: Insider Risk Management keeps its OWN SEPARATE audit log (learn.microsoft.com/en-us/purview/insider-risk-management-audit-log) -- independent from the Microsoft 365 unified audit log that every other 'purview' row in this schema tab represents, with its own 180-day retention (vs. the unified log's own retention policies) and its own access role groups. It has no literal Operation value at all in the unified-audit-log sense: its exported 'Activity' field takes one of 4 generic values (Viewed, Deleted, Added, Edited) crossed against a 'Category' field naming which IRM area was touched (Policies, Cases, Alerts, Settings, Users, Notice templates) -- a combinatorial description, not a documented fixed table of named operations, so listing all 24 combinations as if Microsoft published them as discrete operations would misrepresent the source. Source: Microsoft Learn — insider-risk-management-audit-log and insider-risk-management-activities.
